instantiated_cells.justification: The definition of "lobbyist" includes any individual who "contracts for or receives economic consideration, other than reimbursement for actual expenses" from a principal, establishing no dollar compensation minimum.

instantiated_cells.cited_section: Wis. Stat. § 13.64(1) (2015) (registration trigger) and § 13.621(5) (2015) (verified statement for ≤$500/year)
instantiated_cells.justification: A principal must register only after lobbying expenditures/obligations exceed $500 in a calendar year, and principals anticipating not exceeding $500 may file a verified statement and are not subject to licensing/registration/reporting if true.

unscoreable_emissions.reason: The statutory definition of "lobbyist" in the provided text does not include any lobbyist-side expenditure-based registration trigger; expenditure thresholds shown relate to principal registration/verified statement and reporting, not lobbyist definition.

The provided statute text contains only principal expense statement requirements (Wis. Stat. § 13.68) and does not establish any lobbyist expenditure report or per-item itemization threshold for lobbyists.

No provision in the provided text creates a lobbyist filing exemption based on a percentage of compensated time; the only time-based threshold is a 5-days-per-reporting-period trigger in the lobbyist definition.
